title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - WaterProperty
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/WaterProperty. Class to group those properties related to the water. Subclass of saref:Property (an imported SAREF core class, not separately modeled in this repository), with no properties of its own. This is the parent class of AcceptabilityProperty, ChemicalProperty, and MicrobialProperty (which in turn parents BacterialProperty); the union of all of their named individuals (54 in total) is exactly the controlled vocabulary used as the enum of Water.hasProperty. No individuals are typed directly as WaterProperty itself; see the AcceptabilityProperty, ChemicalProperty, MicrobialProperty, and BacterialProperty models for the full list of individuals grouped under this taxonomy.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'WaterProperty'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
